pitch.class.atamadaka_desc: Drop after mora 1. The first mora is high, everything after is low.
pitch.class.heiban_desc: No drop. Pitch rises after mora 1 and stays high - even on the following particle.
pitch.class.nakadaka_desc: Drop somewhere in the middle. Mora 1 is low, then high, then drops back to low.
pitch.class.odaka_desc: Drop falls on the boundary - only audible when a particle follows.
pitch.contour.instruction: Click HIGH or LOW for each mora. Then press Enter.

test_intro.classifier_drill.body:
Practice matching Chinese nouns with their correct measure word (classifier) — an endless drill, not a scored test.

Use the toggle at the top to switch between Auto (adapts to your mastery), Choose (multiple choice), and Type (type the classifier yourself).
test_intro.classifier_drill.title: Classifier (Measure Word) Drill
test_intro.counter_drill.body:
Practice matching Japanese nouns with their correct counter (助数詞) — an endless drill, not a scored test.

Use the toggle at the top to switch between Auto (adapts to your mastery), Choose (multiple choice), and Type (type the counter yourself).
test_intro.counter_drill.title: Counter Drill
test_intro.dictation.body:
Listen to the audio, then type exactly what you hear into the box.

Submit your answer to see how closely it matches — you can replay the audio as many times as you like.
test_intro.dictation.title: Dictation
test_intro.listening.body:
Press play to hear the audio clip — you can replay it as many times as you need.

Then answer each multiple-choice question based on what you heard.
test_intro.listening.title: Listening Comprehension
test_intro.pinyin.body:
Read through the passage character by character, marking the tone of each one as you go.

Use the arrow keys (or swipe on touch devices): right for Tone 1, up for Tone 2, left for Tone 3, down for Tone 4, and space (or tap) for the neutral tone.
test_intro.pinyin.title: Pinyin Tone Practice
test_intro.pitch_accent.body:
In Quick mode, classify each word's overall pitch pattern — Heiban, Atamadaka, Nakadaka, or Odaka — using the arrow keys or a swipe.

In Contour mode, mark each mora of the word as low or high, then submit.
test_intro.pitch_accent.title: Pitch Accent Practice
test_intro.reading.body:
Read the passage, then answer the multiple-choice questions about it.

There's no time limit, and you can scroll back up to re-read the passage at any point.
test_intro.reading.title: Reading Comprehension
